svg.aria-label: The corpus-synthesis flow: train rows weighted by per-label evidence feed a span-transplant proposer that preserves the gold label, a learner-density gate rejects drift before the teacher is paid, the teacher must agree with the carried gold, survivors are sealed into a digest-verified artifact, and a frozen A/B with echo gates decides whether the win transfers or is memorization
